numeral.purpose: The day on every sheet, always two digits, in the 4rem folio column.

numeral-desk.purpose: The sheet numeral from 1100px (in a 4.5rem column).

numeral-panel.purpose: The small sheet head at the top of the activity panel.

month-title-wall.purpose: The month title from 1280px, when the page becomes a wall calendar.

weekday.purpose: Weekday beside the numeral, in capitals (text-transform: uppercase); 1rem in the panel head.

time.purpose: An activity's start time on its plate, tabular figures; 1.0625rem for "até 12h".

type-label.purpose: The activity type under its time ("Festa", "Plenária", "Prazo").

headline.purpose: The activity title in the panel; text-wrap: balance.

title.purpose: The activity title on its sheet; text-wrap: pretty.

meta.purpose: Organization (600), place, period, facts, chips, notices, the month under the weekday.

caption.purpose: Masthead full name, holiday names (600, red), organizations' full names, the flyer hint.

cell.purpose: Entries written into the wall-sized month page (time at 700; bar titles at 600); column letters use Barlow Condensed 700 at this size.

cell-holiday.purpose: A holiday's short name under its numeral on the wall-sized month page, in red; the "+N" count.

flyer-numeral.purpose: Folha do dia day number (Cartaz 204px, Aviso 290px); base size, js/flyer.js plans the rest inline.

flyer-display.purpose: Cartaz title in capitals; base size, shrinks with the title's length.

flyer-title.purpose: Activity title on the Folha do dia (76px on the month flyer, 64px struck on the Aviso).

flyer-stamp.purpose: "CANCELADA" on the Aviso de cancelamento, tilted -8deg.

shadows.name: sheet-lift
shadows.purpose: The phone's bottom sheet, over the 55% graphite scrim. The desktop panel has none.

shadows.name: bubble
shadows.purpose: The message bubble of the WhatsApp preview.

shadows.name: selected-frame
shadows.purpose: Stroke, not depth: the activity open in the panel, the today ring and (from 1280px) the chosen month cell.

shadows.name: tab-underline
shadows.purpose: Stroke, not depth: the chosen view tab, on the wall above the list or the month page.

shadows.name: hollow-mark
shadows.purpose: Stroke, not depth: a cancelled activity's mark or bar on the month page.

shadows.name: pressed-square-ring
shadows.purpose: Stroke, not depth: the white ring round a pressed chip's sector square.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: The one curve (--ease): bottom sheet slide and view tab underline.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Background, colour and border changes on chips, lines and buttons (default ease).

motion.name: sheet
motion.purpose: The phone's bottom sheet sliding in and out; it follows the finger (--drag) with no transition while dragged.

motion.name: flash
motion.purpose: How long a done button keeps its confirmation ("Copiado", "Imagem baixada", "Compartilhado").

breakpoints.name: wide-phone
breakpoints.purpose: 24px gutters, the bottom sheet centred at 560px, 64px month cells.

breakpoints.name: desk
breakpoints.purpose: Two columns: pad + sticky panel (380px); must match `desktop` in js/app.js.

breakpoints.name: wall
breakpoints.purpose: Panel 420px; the month page with titles written in.

breakpoints.name: narrow
breakpoints.purpose: 359px at 16px: sheet heads and lines reflow.

breakpoints.name: short-phone
breakpoints.purpose: Panfleto opens at the format bar; smaller preview.

breakpoints.name: short-desk
breakpoints.purpose: Flyer mode folds the organization and the hint.

breakpoints.name: shell
breakpoints.purpose: Desk shell with 32px padding: 1280px of content.

roles.name: --role-wall
roles.purpose: Page background; flyers' ground; flyer preview frame.

roles.name: --role-paper
roles.purpose: Sheets, the panel, chips, pills, icon buttons, segments.

roles.name: --role-paper-hover
roles.purpose: An activity line under the pointer.

roles.name: --role-ink
roles.purpose: Text.

roles.name: --role-ink-soft
roles.purpose: Secondary text and icons.

roles.name: --role-ink-faded
roles.purpose: Perforation of the mark and of the Cartaz and Aviso flyers.

roles.name: --role-ink-past
roles.purpose: Numerals of past sheets and of days outside the month (3:1 on paper).

roles.name: --role-line
roles.purpose: 1px seams, sheet edges, perforation dots, the grabber.

roles.name: --role-header
roles.purpose: The printed header card; the Cartaz ground.

roles.name: --role-on-header
roles.purpose: Text and focus on the header card.

roles.name: --role-binding
roles.purpose: The strip on top of each sheet.

roles.name: --role-mark-loop
roles.purpose: The O of the NOS mark where the mark prints on paper: the app icons, the favicons, the link preview.

roles.name: --role-red-letter
roles.purpose: Sundays and national holidays.

roles.name: --role-red-letter-past
roles.purpose: Red-letter numerals of past sheets and outside the month.

roles.name: --role-accent
roles.purpose: The panel's primary action; text selection; the caret.

roles.name: --role-accent-hover
roles.purpose: Hover of the primary action.

roles.name: --role-on-accent
roles.purpose: Label on the primary action; selected text.

roles.name: --role-selected
roles.purpose: The activity open in the panel.

roles.name: --role-alert
roles.purpose: Error icons; on flyers the Cancelada stamp, the strike through a cancelled date, the circled day.

roles.name: --role-alert-text
roles.purpose: Small red text: the on-screen stamp, cancellation reasons.

roles.name: --role-alert-soft
roles.purpose: Error notice ground.

roles.name: --role-alert-ring
roles.purpose: Error notice border.

roles.name: --role-next
roles.purpose: The next activity, nothing else.

roles.name: --role-on-next
roles.purpose: Text on the next activity's badge and plate.

roles.name: --role-strong
roles.purpose: On states (pressed chip, active pill, chosen segment, Hoje, chosen day, done button, the chosen view tab's underline), city and type tags, line-button borders.

roles.name: --role-on-strong
roles.purpose: Text on graphite fills.

roles.name: --role-on-series
roles.purpose: Titles on sector-coloured month bars.

roles.name: --role-focus
roles.purpose: Focus ring.

roles.name: --role-focus-on-color
roles.purpose: Focus ring on the red header and the chosen segment.

roles.name: --role-scrim
roles.purpose: Backdrop behind the phone's bottom sheet.

roles.name: --role-shadow
roles.purpose: The three soft shadows.

roles.name: --role-wash
roles.purpose: Hover wash on quiet controls; inline code ground.

roles.name: --role-scrollbar
roles.purpose: Scrollbar.

roles.name: --role-chat
roles.purpose: WhatsApp preview background.

roles.name: --role-bubble
roles.purpose: WhatsApp preview bubble.

roles.name: --role-series-1
roles.purpose: Sector ink 1; js/colors.js sets it as --sector.

roles.name: --role-series-2
roles.purpose: Sector ink 2; js/colors.js sets it as --sector.

roles.name: --role-series-3
roles.purpose: Sector ink 3; js/colors.js sets it as --sector.

roles.name: --role-series-4
roles.purpose: Sector ink 4; js/colors.js sets it as --sector.

roles.name: --role-series-5
roles.purpose: Sector ink 5; js/colors.js sets it as --sector.

roles.name: --role-series-6
roles.purpose: Sector ink 6; js/colors.js sets it as --sector.

roles.name: --role-series-7
roles.purpose: Sector ink 7; js/colors.js sets it as --sector.

roles.name: --role-series-8
roles.purpose: Sector ink 8; js/colors.js sets it as --sector.

roles.name: --role-no-sector
roles.purpose: Square of an activity without a sector.

themes.selector: :root[data-theme='<name>'] in css/theme.css, overriding palette entries or roles

themes.name: exemplo
themes.purpose: Template: a graphite header card and binding.

styles.name: Folha do dia
styles.purpose: One giant sheet: 460px numeral, weekday, month and year, time; title, organization, type tag.

styles.name: Calendário do mês
styles.purpose: The month page with the day circled by hand in red; title, date and time, place, organization.

styles.name: Cartaz
styles.purpose: The header card at poster size: red ground, white capital title, a white day sheet with a graphite binding, NOS signature.

styles.name: Aviso de cancelamento
styles.purpose: Forced for cancelled activities: the sheet's numeral struck in red under the CANCELADA stamp, the reason, the struck title.

flyers.margins: 60px (Folha do dia, Calendário do mês), 80px (Cartaz, Aviso)
flyers.planning: js/flyer.js plans sizes and line breaks from embedded Barlow glyph widths (no DOM measurement) and sets them inline in whole pixels; css/flyers.css holds the base sizes, every rule scoped under .fl.

components.name: Accent Button
components.description: The panel's one primary action: Enviar no WhatsApp, Compartilhar imagem, or Baixar PNG when files can't be shared.
components.css: .ds-btn-accent, .ds-btn-accent *, .ds-btn-accent *::before, .ds-btn-accent *::after { box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-btn-accent { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 18px; border: 2px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius, 6px); background: var(--role-accent, #E4002B); color: var(--role-on-accent, #FFFFFF); font: 700 1rem/1.15 var(--font-ui, 'Barlow', system-ui, sans-serif); text-align: center; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s, color 0.15s, border-color 0.15s; } .ds-btn-accent-icon { width: 20px; height: 20px; flex: none; } .ds-btn-accent:hover { background: var(--role-accent-hover, #C70026); } .ds-btn-accent:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--role-focus, #1C1C1E); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-accent:disabled { cursor: progress; opacity: 0.7; }

components.name: Line Button
components.description: The secondary action (Copiar texto, Baixar PNG beside Compartilhar imagem); fills graphite on hover and for 2s once done (Copiado).
components.css: .ds-btn-line, .ds-btn-line *, .ds-btn-line *::before, .ds-btn-line *::after { box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-btn-line { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 18px; border: 2px solid var(--role-strong, #1C1C1E); border-radius: var(--radius, 6px); background: transparent; color: var(--role-ink, #1C1C1E); font: 700 1rem/1.15 var(--font-ui, 'Barlow', system-ui, sans-serif); text-align: center; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s, color 0.15s, border-color 0.15s; } .ds-btn-line-icon { width: 20px; height: 20px; flex: none; } .ds-btn-line:hover, .ds-btn-line.is-done { background: var(--role-strong, #1C1C1E); color: var(--role-on-strong, #FFFFFF); } .ds-btn-line:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--role-focus, #1C1C1E); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Sector Chips
components.description: Sector filter: "Todos" first, then one pill per sector with its printed square; pressed fills graphite.
components.css: .ds-chips, .ds-chips *, .ds-chips *::before, .ds-chips *::after { box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-chips { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; } .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid var(--role-line, #D9D9D4); border-radius: var(--radius-pill, 999px); background: var(--role-paper, #FFFFFF); color: var(--role-ink, #1C1C1E); font-family: var(--font-ui, 'Barlow', system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s, border-color 0.15s, color 0.15s; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: var(--role-strong, #1C1C1E); } .ds-chip[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--role-strong, #1C1C1E); border-color: var(--role-strong, #1C1C1E); color: var(--role-on-strong, #FFFFFF); font-weight: 600; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--role-focus, #1C1C1E); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-chip-square { flex: none; width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--sector, var(--role-no-sector, #5C5C61)); } .ds-chip[aria-pressed="true"] .ds-chip-square { box-shadow: 0 0 0 1.5px var(--role-on-strong, #FFFFFF); }

components.name: Organization Pill
components.description: Organization filter: a native select laid over a pill face; options carry full names grouped by sector; fills graphite while active.
components.html: Organização
components.css: .ds-org-pill, .ds-org-pill *, .ds-org-pill *::before, .ds-org-pill *::after { box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-org-pill { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; } .ds-org-face { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; max-width: 15rem; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1.5px solid var(--role-strong, #1C1C1E); border-radius: var(--radius-pill, 999px); background: var(--role-paper, #FFFFFF); color: var(--role-ink, #1C1C1E); font-family: var(--font-ui, 'Barlow', system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 600; pointer-events: none; } .ds-org-icon { width: 18px; height: 18px; flex: none; } .ds-org-chevron { width: 16px; height: 16px; flex: none; } .ds-org-label { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-org-select { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; opacity: 0; cursor: pointer; font-size: 1rem; } .ds-org-pill:has(.ds-org-select:focus-visible) .ds-org-face { outline: 3px solid var(--role-focus, #1C1C1E); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-org-pill.is-active .ds-org-face { background: var(--role-strong, #1C1C1E); color: var(--role-on-strong, #FFFFFF); }

components.name: View Tabs
components.description: Agenda | Mês on the wall, directly on top of the list or the month page they switch (under the filters): grey labels on a seam, the chosen one graphite and bold over a 4px graphite underline.
components.css: .ds-tabs, .ds-tabs *, .ds-tabs *::before, .ds-tabs *::after { box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-tabs { display: flex; max-width: 390px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--role-line, #D9D9D4); } .ds-tab { flex: 1; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 49px; padding: 0 12px 4px; border: 0; background: none; color: var(--role-ink-soft, #5C5C61); font-family: var(--font-ui, 'Barlow', system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: inset 0 -4px 0 transparent; transition: box-shadow 0.2s var(--ease, cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)), color 0.15s; } .ds-tab-icon { width: 18px; height: 18px; flex: none; } .ds-tab:hover { color: var(--role-ink, #1C1C1E); } .ds-tab[aria-selected="true"] { color: var(--role-ink, #1C1C1E); font-weight: 700; box-shadow: inset 0 -4px 0 var(--role-strong, #1C1C1E); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--role-focus, #1C1C1E); outline-offset: -4px; }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: Mensagem | Panfleto in the panel: a graphite frame split in two; the chosen half fills graphite.
components.css: .ds-seg, .ds-seg *, .ds-seg *::before, .ds-seg *::after { box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-seg { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; max-width: 380px; border: 1px solid var(--role-strong, #1C1C1E); border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 4px); overflow: hidden; } .ds-seg-tab { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 44px; border: 0; background: var(--role-paper, #FFFFFF); color: var(--role-ink, #1C1C1E); font-family: var(--font-ui, 'Barlow', system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .ds-seg-tab + .ds-seg-tab { border-left: 1px solid var(--role-strong, #1C1C1E); } .ds-seg-icon { width: 20px; height: 20px; flex: none; } .ds-seg-tab[aria-selected="true"] { background: var(--role-strong, #1C1C1E); color: var(--role-on-strong, #FFFFFF); } .ds-seg-tab:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--role-focus, #1C1C1E); outline-offset: -4px; } .ds-seg-tab[aria-selected="true"]:focus-visible { outline-color: var(--role-focus-on-color, #FFFFFF); }

components.name: Day Sheet
components.description: Signature: a sheet of the folhinha with its binding strip, perforation, two-digit numeral (red on Sundays and holidays), status badge and the day's activities; the next one's time sits on the yellow plate.
components.html: 18domingoOutubroPróxima
components.css: .ds-sheet, .ds-sheet *, .ds-sheet *::before, .ds-sheet *::after { box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-sheet { max-width: 560px; background: var(--role-paper, #FFFFFF); color: var(--role-ink, #1C1C1E); border: 1px solid var(--role-line, #D9D9D4); border-top: 0; border-radius: 2px 2px var(--radius, 6px) var(--radius, 6px); overflow: hidden; font: 500 1rem/1.45 var(--font-ui, 'Barlow', system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-sheet::before { content: ''; display: block; height: 13px; background: linear-gradient(var(--role-binding, #E4002B), var(--role-binding, #E4002B)) top / 100% 4px no-repeat, radial-gradient(circle, var(--role-line, #D9D9D4) 1.5px, transparent 1.75px) 12px 8px / 10px 3px repeat-x; } .ds-sheet-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 4px 12px 12px 16px; } .ds-sheet-num { flex: none; width: 4rem; font: 800 3.625rem/0.9 var(--font-display, 'Barlow Condensed', 'Barlow', system-ui, sans-serif); letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-sheet-names { flex: 1; min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 3px; } .ds-sheet-weekday { font: 700 1.1875rem/1.1 var(--font-display, 'Barlow Condensed', 'Barlow', system-ui, sans-serif); letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-sheet-month { font-size: 0.9375rem; line-height: 1.2; color: var(--role-ink-soft, #5C5C61); } .ds-sheet.is-red .ds-sheet-num, .ds-sheet.is-red .ds-sheet-weekday { color: var(--role-red-letter, #E4002B); } .ds-badge { flex: none; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 1.625em; padding: 0 9px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 4px); font: 700 1rem/1 var(--font-display, 'Barlow Condensed', 'Barlow', system-ui, sans-serif); letter-spacing: 0.02em; } .ds-badge-next { background: var(--role-next, #FFC20E); color: var(--role-on-next, #1C1C1E); } .ds-lines { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; } .ds-line { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 12px; width: 100%; padding: 14px 6px 14px 16px; border: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--role-line, #D9D9D4); background: var(--role-paper, #FFFFFF); color: inherit; font: inherit; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-line:hover { background: var(--role-paper-hover, #F7F7F5); } .ds-line:hover .ds-line-title { text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-thickness: 1px; } .ds-line:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--role-focus, #1C1C1E); outline-offset: -3px; } .ds-line-time { flex: none; width: 4rem; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 4px; } .ds-line-clock { padding: 1px 5px; margin-left: -5px; border-radius: 3px; font: 700 1.375rem/1.1 var(--font-display, 'Barlow Condensed', 'Barlow', system-ui, sans-serif); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-line.is-next .ds-line-clock { background: var(--role-next, #FFC20E); color: var(--role-on-next, #1C1C1E); } .ds-line-type { font: 600 0.9375rem/1.15 var(--font-display, 'Barlow Condensed', 'Barlow', system-ui, sans-serif); color: var(--role-ink-soft, #5C5C61); } .ds-line-body { flex: 1; min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 6px; } .ds-line-title { font-size: 1.0625rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.3; } .ds-line-org, .ds-line-place { display: flex; gap: 8px; font-size: 0.9375rem; line-height: 1.35; } .ds-line-org { align-items: center; font-weight: 600; } .ds-line-place { gap: 6px; color: var(--role-ink-soft, #5C5C61); } .ds-line-place-icon { width: 16px; height: 16px; margin-top: 1px; flex: none; } .ds-square { flex: none; width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--sector, var(--role-no-sector, #5C5C61)); } .ds-line-go { flex: none; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; margin: -10px 0; } .ds-line-go-icon { width: 20px; height: 20px; }

components.name: Cancellation Stamp
components.description: A cancelled activity stays on its sheet: the tilted CANCELADA rubber stamp above the struck title and time, the reason in Deep Red.
components.html: 15hPlenáriaCanceladaConselho de Entidades de Base extraordinárioMotivo: O DCE cancelou todas as suas atividades de 09/10.DCE UFGD
components.css: .ds-cancel, .ds-cancel *, .ds-cancel *::before, .ds-cancel *::after { box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-cancel { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 12px; max-width: 560px; padding: 14px 16px; background: var(--role-paper, #FFFFFF); color: var(--role-ink, #1C1C1E); border: 1px solid var(--role-line, #D9D9D4); border-radius: var(--radius, 6px); font: 500 1rem/1.45 var(--font-ui, 'Barlow', system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-cancel-time { flex: none; width: 4rem; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 4px; } .ds-cancel-clock { font: 700 1.375rem/1.1 var(--font-display, 'Barlow Condensed', 'Barlow', system-ui, sans-serif); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--role-ink-soft, #5C5C61); text-decoration: line-through; } .ds-cancel-type { font: 600 0.9375rem/1.15 var(--font-display, 'Barlow Condensed', 'Barlow', system-ui, sans-serif); color: var(--role-ink-soft, #5C5C61); } .ds-cancel-body { flex: 1; min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 6px; } .ds-stamp { display: inline-block; padding: 2px 7px; border: 2px solid var(--role-alert-text, #C70026); border-radius: 3px; color: var(--role-alert-text, #C70026); font: 800 0.875rem/1.2 var(--font-display, 'Barlow Condensed', 'Barlow', system-ui, sans-serif); letter-spacing: 0.11em; text-transform: uppercase; rotate: -3deg; } .ds-cancel-title { font-size: 1.0625rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.3; color: var(--role-ink-soft, #5C5C61); text-decoration: line-through; } .ds-cancel-reason { font-size: 0.9375rem; line-height: 1.35; font-weight: 500; color: var(--role-alert-text, #C70026); } .ds-cancel-org { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-size: 0.9375rem; line-height: 1.35; font-weight: 600; } .ds-cancel-square { flex: none; width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--sector, var(--role-no-sector, #5C5C61)); }

components.name: Masthead and NOS Mark

narrative.overview:
NOS Dourados is drawn as a folhinha, the tear-off wall calendar of Brazilian homes and shops. A red printed header card hangs at the top; under it, on a pale wall, hangs a pad of white day sheets, each bound by a red strip and a row of perforation holes, each with a giant two-digit numeral and its weekday in condensed capitals, and every organization's activities are printed on the sheet of their day. Today's sheet is on top, past sheets are torn off until someone asks for them, the next activity carries the calendar's only yellow, Sundays and national holidays print in red, and a cancelled activity keeps its place under a red rubber stamp. The month view is the calendar's month page, Sunday first; the flyers are the same header card and sheets at poster size.

The system is printed, not decorated. One type family, Barlow and Barlow Condensed, with hierarchy carried by scale and width; flat paper on a wall, separated by 1px seams; corners that stay nearly square where a sheet is bound and soften where it hangs free; colour used the way a calendar printer uses it: red for the header, the binding and the red-letter days, graphite for everything printed, one yellow for "Próxima", eight sector inks as small printed squares. Density is set for mid-range phones used outdoors: big numerals, strong contrast, tap targets of 44px and more. Motion is minimal: state changes fade in 0.15s, the view tab underline moves in 0.2s and the phone's bottom sheet slides in 0.3s, all on one curve (`--ease`, `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)`); with reduced motion every transition is instant.

It refuses the category default of event apps (a grey list with thin date dividers and coloured event pills) and the protest-poster costume. Only the palette comes from the Calendário de Luta this repository was copied from; its metro line, stations, countdown and slogan are retired.
keyCharacteristics: Every day is a sheet: red binding strip, perforation row, two-digit numeral, weekday in condensed capitals.
Sundays and national holidays print red on every calendar surface.
Yellow means the next activity and nothing else.
A sector is a small printed square beside the organization, never a fill behind content.
One family, hierarchy by scale: Barlow Condensed prints the calendar, Barlow carries what people read.
Flat sheets on a pale wall with 1px seams; shadows only on what floats.
Every colour is a variable in two layers, palette then roles, so a theme is one block of variables.

rules.name: The Roles-Only Rule
rules.body: `css/style.css` and `css/flyers.css` name roles, never palette variables or colour literals; `transparent`, `currentColor` and, inside `@media (forced-colors: active)`, system colours are the only exceptions. A new colour enters `css/theme.css` as a palette entry plus a role, and a sector's colour arrives only as `var(--sector)`.

rules.name: The One Yellow Rule
rules.body: Próxima Yellow marks the next activity and nothing else: the "Próxima" badge on its start day's sheet and the plate behind its time (or its dash, when that day has several activities or is today). It never marks focus, warnings, the month grid or a flyer.

rules.name: The Red-Letter Rule
rules.body: Sundays and national holidays print in Folhinha Red wherever the calendar prints a date: the sheet's numeral and weekday, the holiday's name, the month page's Sunday column and numerals, the Folha do dia and the Calendário do mês. Red on a date means a Sunday or a holiday, never decoration. A torn-off sheet keeps its red numeral, faded to Faded Red-Letter; the month page fades it only outside the month.

rules.name: The Printed Square Rule
rules.body: A sector shows as a small square of its ink beside the organization: 10px with 2px corners on screen, 6px with 1px corners in month cells, 0.7em on flyers. The only larger sector fills are the multi-day bars of the month page. Sector colour never fills a card, a chip or a line, and never colours text.

rules.name: The Two-Digit Numeral Rule
rules.body: A sheet prints its day with two digits ("09"), as printed folhinhas do: the agenda's sheets, the panel head, the Folha do dia, the Cartaz and the Aviso de cancelamento. The month page keeps plain numerals ("9"), as month pages do.

rules.name: The Printer and Reader Rule
rules.body: Barlow Condensed prints the calendar: numerals, weekdays, times, types, month names, badges, the stamp, the masthead. Barlow carries what people read: titles, organizations, places, descriptions, buttons. No third family, and no weight beyond the six that are self-hosted.

rules.name: The Folio Column Rule
rules.body: The numeral and the activity times share one fixed column (4rem; 4.5rem from 1100px), and the weekday, the month and the activity titles share the next, so every sheet head sits at the same scale and baseline and the times read down the pad like a split-flap board, in tabular figures. An empty day's line ("Nenhuma atividade hoje") starts in the text column too.

rules.name: The Flat Wall Rule
rules.body: Nothing printed casts a shadow. Sheets, the month page and the desktop panel are paper on the wall, edged by 1px seams; only the phone's bottom sheet and the chat bubble float.

rules.name: The Bound Top Rule
rules.body: Anything shown as a sheet is bound at the top and free at the bottom: a binding strip, a perforation row, nearly square top corners (2px) and softer bottom corners (6px; 8px on the desktop panel). The agenda's day sheets, the month page, the desktop panel, the flyer sheets and the link preview's sheet share this silhouette.

rules.name: The Hand-Applied Tilt Rule
rules.body: Only what a hand would add is tilted: the "Cancelada" stamp (-3° on screen, -8° on the Aviso), and on the month flyer the circled day (-7°) and the stroke under the other days of a long activity (-2°), and the O of the NOS mark, circled at -9°. Everything printed stays square to its sheet.

rules.name: The Ink State Rule
rules.body: "On" is graphite: a graphite fill with white text for the pressed sector chip, the active organization pill, the chosen segment, the "Hoje" badge, the chosen day on the phone's month page and a line button once its action is done; graphite text over a 4px graphite underline for the chosen view tab. Only the activity open in the panel is tinted, Blush Tint inside a 2px graphite frame.

rules.name: The Stamp, Don't Erase Rule
rules.body: A cancelled activity is never removed, never hidden and never the next one: it stays on its sheet under the "Cancelada" stamp, struck through, with its reason in Deep Red; on the month page its mark or bar turns hollow, and its flyer becomes the Aviso de cancelamento.

dos: Do style every new surface with roles (`var(--role-*)`) from `css/theme.css`; when a colour is missing, add a palette entry and a role there.
Do give anything presented as a sheet the folhinha's top: a 4px binding strip and a perforation row (13px together), 2px top corners, 6px bottom corners and a 1px Seam Grey edge.
Do print a sheet's day with two digits in Barlow Condensed 800, in the folio column the times share (4rem; 4.5rem from 1100px), with tabular figures for times.
Do print Sundays and national holidays in red on every calendar surface, and start month pages on Sunday.
Do show "on" states with a graphite fill and white text, and keep every tap target at 44px or more (48px for the panel's actions).
Do keep a cancelled activity on its sheet with the "Cancelada" stamp, the struck title and time, and "Motivo: …" in Deep Red.
Do size interface text, and the boxes that hold text, in rem; keep flyers in px on the 1080 × 1350 canvas, with sizes planned by `js/flyer.js`.
Do add a theme as a `:root[data-theme='name']` block that overrides palette entries or roles, try it with `?tema=<name>`, and update the `theme-color` meta by hand.
donts: Don't write a hex, rgb or named colour, or a `--color-*` palette variable, in `css/style.css` or `css/flyers.css`; `transparent`, `currentColor` and system colours inside `forced-colors` are the only exceptions.
Don't use Próxima Yellow (#FFC20E) for anything but the next activity: not for focus rings, highlights or warnings, not on the month grid, not on flyers.
Don't reduce the days to thin date dividers in one grey list, or print activities as coloured event pills: each day is a sheet, and a sector is a small square beside the organization.
Don't fill cards, chips, lines or text with a sector colour; the only sector fills are the squares and the month page's multi-day bars.
Don't put on the protest-poster costume: no raised fists, megaphones, stencil or distressed type, halftone or grunge textures. The Cartaz is the red header card at poster size with a day sheet on it.
Don't bring back the retired Calendário de Luta devices: the metro line to election day, stations, countdowns, campaign slogans.
Don't add a typeface outside the Barlow superfamily, or a weight that isn't self-hosted (Barlow 500, 600, 700; Barlow Condensed 600, 700, 800).
Don't lift sheets, the month page or the desktop panel with shadows; shadows belong to what floats (the phone's bottom sheet, the chat bubble).
Don't tilt printed content; rotation belongs to hand-applied marks (the stamp, the circled day and its underline, the O of the NOS mark).
Don't invent logos, photos or slogans for the organizations; they are named in text, with their full names where they are known.
